source: MarineCadastre.gov Vessel Traffic (AIS) daily points, BOEM + NOAA Office for Coastal Management, from the U.S. Coast Guard national AIS network
attribution: Ship positions: MarineCadastre.gov (BOEM, NOAA OCM, U.S. Coast Guard). U.S. Government material, not subject to copyright protection within the United States (17 U.S.C. 403).
privacy: Pleasure craft, sailing, military, law-enforcement and other/unknown-type vessels removed entirely; no MMSI, IMO, call sign or vessel name stored.
trackThinning: real AIS reports only; per vessel a point is dropped if < 30 s after the previous kept point or at the identical position (4-decimal, ~11 m); coordinates rounded to 4 decimals
